caption: The drawing depicts a full-body figure of a person standing against a plain, light-colored background. The person is illustrated with dark skin and curly black hair. They are dressed in a long-sleeved, high-collared jacket that is pink with gold trim and decorative patterns on the chest and cuffs. The trousers are loose-fitting, black or dark gray in color, with a distinct red stripe running down the outside seam of each leg. The figure's shoes are also dark. The person’s right hand is raised to touch their forehead, while the left arm hangs down by their side. There is a signature reading "EMILE CERO" in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Bell Hop Marionette
